CYP2D6 is highly polymorphic — poor metabolizers (PMs, ~5-10% of Caucasians) lack functional enzyme, while ultra-rapid metabolizers carry gene duplications, creating large inter-individual variability in drug exposure.

Molecular features strongly associated with being a CYP2D6 substrate: the presence of a basic nitrogen atom (pKa > 7, typically a secondary or tertiary amine) that is protonated at physiological pH and can form an ion pair with Asp301 — this is the single most important feature. A planar hydrophobic region (usually an aromatic ring) adjacent to the metabolic site that fits into the hydrophobic pocket of the active site.
